entries.name: Cross-Sectional Crash Tail-Risk Beta
entries.signal: Estimate downside-tail factor from cross-sectional crashes, lagged tail beta; rank exposures monthly; first use risk filter
entries.empirical: Original paper: high minus low tail-risk loading portfolios differ by 5.4% annual three-factor alpha, historical, not costed strategy
entries.overlap: QSI-075 expected idiosyncratic skewness is individual positive-tail lottery; QSI-106 common negative crash risk loading

entries.name: Customer-Supplier Economic Link Momentum
entries.signal: Rank suppliers by major customers' lagged monthly returns, rebalance monthly, sector neutral
entries.empirical: Original research long-short monthly alpha over 150 bps in historical sample; no verified post-cost Sharpe or max DD
entries.overlap: QSI-066 industry momentum uses sector aggregate; QSI-107 uses disclosed directed customer-supplier links

entries.name: Total Asset Growth Anomaly
entries.signal: Long lowest annual total asset growth quintile; high growth as short research or exclusion, rebalance monthly
entries.empirical: Original study: asset growth predicts future abnormal returns including large caps; numeric costed Sharpe/DD not verified
entries.overlap: QSI-101 NOA is cumulative net operating balance sheet, QSI-108 is annual total asset investment change

entries.name: Operating Leverage Cross-Sectional Premium
entries.signal: Rank robust operating leverage proxy within industry after PIT filings; investigate high-minus-low premium
entries.empirical: Original paper reports significant operating-leverage sort excess returns; exact costed Sharpe/DD not verified
entries.overlap: QSI-102 organization capital is capitalized SG&A knowledge; QSI-109 fixed operating cost exposure to demand shocks

entries.name: Intangible Return Reversal
entries.signal: Train PIT fundamental news model on past data; monthly rank residual intangible return; low residual long research
entries.empirical: Original paper: future return negatively related to intangible past return; no verified numeric net Sharpe/DD
entries.overlap: QSI-076 IPCA models dynamic latent risk exposures; QSI-110 decomposes historical return into tangible and intangible accounting-news components
